headline: Ahead of the public release of low-PBR companies... 'Rights issues and CBs will decline'
summary: Publication of the list of undervalued listed companies is just over a month away. Firms disclosing PBR improvement and value enhancement plans by 22 October can be exempt from the list for one year.
why: Korea's low price-to-book list pressures companies to improve shareholder returns, affecting share prices and capital-raising plans. Investors watch these measures for their effect on Korean equities.
